summary: YPF S.A., the Argentine energy company, filed a 6-K disclosing the September 16, 2026 expiration of its voluntary cash tender offer for up to U.S.$1,000,000,000 aggregate purchase price of its 6.950% Senior Notes due 2027 and 2.500%/9.000% Step Up Amortizing Notes due 2029. Holders tendered U.S.$318,514,000 of 2027s (all accepted, U.S.$1,017.50 per U.S.$1,000) and U.S.$247,608,703 of 2029s (all accepted, U.S.$1,042.00 before the 0.85714 amortization factor). No board recommendation or advisor named. The offer was oversubscribed relative to the stated cap, and no global proration was required.
